configuration.title: JCode Remote SSH/SFTP
configuration.pollInterval: Interval in milliseconds for checking remote files and folders for changes. Changes apply without reconnecting.
configuration.pollMaxEntries: Most files and folders that change detection tracks for one watched folder. A folder that would exceed this is not checked for changes. Exclude large folders with `files.watcherExclude` to keep the rest up to date.
